description.p: This page documents the visible properties returned by properties for an implicitfunctionline graphics object.

tr.td: updates annotation metadata used by graphics inspection.
Type: graphics annotation object or empty handle value. Supported values: annotation handle or empty handle.
reports object deletion state.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'off', 'on'.
controls callback queuing while another callback is running.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'queue', 'cancel'.
runs when the object receives a mouse-button event.
Type: callback value. Supported values: [], function handle, character vector, string scalar, or callback cell array.
stores child graphics handles.
Type: graphics object handle vector. Supported values: empty vector or child handles.
controls clipping to the parent axes.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'on', 'off'.
sets the implicit curve color.
Type: RGB triplet or color name. Supported values: RGB triplet, short color name, or long color name.
'auto' lets Nelson recompute the paired property; 'manual' preserves the assigned value.

attaches a context menu to the object.
Type: graphics object handle scalar. Supported values: [] or a uicontextmenu handle.
stores generated contour segment data.
Type: numeric matrix. Supported values: [] or a contour matrix.
runs when the object is created.
Type: callback value. Supported values: [], function handle, character vector, string scalar, or callback cell array.

sets internal filled contour color.

controls internal contour filling.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'off', 'on'.
controls whether contours use their level as z-coordinate.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'off', 'on'.
sets the function sampled to generate the implicit curve.
Type: function handle. Supported values: scalar function handle with two inputs.
controls handle discovery.
Type: text scalar or character row vector. Supported values: 'on', 'off', 'callback'.
